latest.title: The Optimal Scaling Parameter in Metric Cotype for Alexandrov Spaces of Nonnegative Curvature
latest.abstract: We determine the optimal order of the scaling parameter in the metric cotype $2$ inequality for complete Alexandrov spaces of nonnegative curvature. It grows linearly with the dimension $n$ of the discrete torus. This answers Question 17 of Eskenazis, Mendel, and Naor. In their sign-vector normalization on $\bigl(\mathbb{Z}/(2m\mathbb{Z})\bigr)^n$, the square of the optimal metric cotype $2$ constant for this class lies between $\max\{1,n/m\}$ and $e\lceil n/m\rceil$ for every dyadic $m\geq 2$. The upper bound follows from a dyadic Bernoulli-thinning argument using only the Lang--Schroeder--Sturm inequality. Snowflake universality of the fixed Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ gives the $n/m$ lower bound.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 确定非负曲率完备 Alexandrov 空间度量 cotype 2 的最优尺度为离散环面维数线性量级。
latest.breakthrough: 以匹配上下界区分此类空间的最优非线性尺度。
latest.limitations: 须按文章的符号向量及 dyadic 参数归一化理解常数。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
